d:
"Shayad Meri Shaadi Ka Khayal" is a popular song from the movie "Souten" (1983), featuring Rajesh Khanna, Tina Munim, and Padmini Kolhapure."Shayad Meri Shaadi Ka Khayal" became a huge hit and is remembered as one of the most romantic songs from the 80s era of Bollywood.
Song: Shayad Meri Shaadi Ka Khayal
Movie: Souten (1983)
Actor(s): Rajesh Khanna, Tina Munim
Singer(s): Lata Mangeshkar & Kishore Kumar
Music: Usha Khanna
Lyricist: Saawan Kumar, Pradip Kaushik
